description: Provision lead delivery for this ChatGPT Ads account. OMIT destinationUrl to deliver to HERMOSO: leads land in Hermoso’s own signed receiver, list_openai_ads_leads reads them and the HubSpot lead sync can push them into HubSpot (no secret to store). Or pass your own https destinationUrl (a managed webhook), optionally with your own signingSecret; then THE SIGNING SECRET IS RETURNED ONCE — every lead webhook is signed with it. Needs ChatGPT Ads connected.

destinationUrl.description: omit to deliver the leads to Hermoso

signingSecret.description: your own webhook signing secret; only used with destinationUrl, returned once

name: set_openai_ads_lead_sync
title: Provision ChatGPT Ads lead delivery (webhook)
